name: InfraPilot AI
statusNote: Runs locally with clearly labelled demo data; live Bedrock mode is optional. Hosted status not confirmed.
summary: AWS architecture design and review. Describe requirements or upload a diagram, get security, cost, reliability and scalability gaps with evidence, an optimised design, and Draw.io, PNG and Excel exports.

caseStudy.problem: Architecture reviews are slow and inconsistent. Teams need a repeatable way to check a design for security, cost, reliability and scalability gaps before building it.
approach: Capture business requirements, then generate an architecture with Amazon Bedrock or upload an existing Draw.io file.
A deterministic rules engine returns Pass, Fail, Warning, Unknown or Not Applicable, kept separate from AI suggestions.
Propose an optimised design and compare it with the original.

architecture.caption: Serverless: static SPA plus a Lambda API.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.note: HTTP API in front of the backend.

nodes.label: Bedrock (optional)
nodes.note: Generation and gap suggestions. DEMO_MODE avoids Bedrock spend.

decisions: Rules first, AI second: the deterministic engine gives evidence, the model adds suggestions.
Scope boundary: the product designs and reviews architectures only and never deploys customer infrastructure.
Demo mode with labelled sample data keeps development free of model spend.
security: The deploy workflow assumes an AWS role through GitHub OIDC; no long-lived AWS keys are stored in the repository.
Bedrock access is optional and off in demo mode.
deployment: CI runs Ruff, pytest, a Lambda package smoke build and the frontend build on every change.
A separate deploy workflow ships the backend and frontend to AWS.
limitations: PNG export is a placeholder diagram (per README).
